facts.fact: Minister Savannah Maziya said Eswatini already has the Computer Crime and Cybercrime Act as legal groundwork, with its regulations at an advanced stage.
Minister Savannah Maziya opened the first national stakeholder workshop to begin drafting a National Data Policy, with a public comment period planned.

SWZ.note: Only a National Data Centre keeping government data locally and a draft policy expected to cover cross-border flows; no localisation rule is stated.

facts.fact: Minister Savannah Maziya said Eswatini already has the Data Protection Act as legal groundwork.
Minister Savannah Maziya said regulations for the data protection law were at an advanced stage, not yet issued.
Minister Savannah Maziya listed the Electronic Transactions Act of 2022 among Eswatini's existing legal groundwork.

SWZ.note: Smart Africa sponsors and supports the policy process, but the document states no membership or signed agreement.
